hub.title: Telegram
hub.intro: Deploy a Telegram bot to automate messaging workflows, handle client support, and broadcast updates to your subscribers worldwide.
hub.loadError: Could not load your Telegram bots.
hub.botCardBody: Paste a bot token from @BotFather to automate messaging, handle support, and broadcast to your subscribers.
hub.accountCardBody: Link your Telegram account to create bots right here — scan a QR or use your phone number, just like WhatsApp.
hub.accountUnavailable: Not available yet: it needs the Telegram account service, which is not set up in this workspace.
hub.guideBody: Complete these steps to link your Telegram channel and enable automated workflows.

pre.name: A unique name for your bot

locate.title: Locate BotFather
locate.body: Open Telegram and search for the official @BotFather account (look for the verified badge).

create.title: Create a new bot
create.body: Send /newbot to @BotFather and follow the prompts to name your bot and pick a username.

token.title: Retrieve API token
token.body: BotFather generates an HTTP API token (e.g. 123456789:ABC…). Copy it safely.

connect.title: Connect the bot here
connect.body: Click “Connect Bot”, paste your token in the box, and submit to finish the link.

support.title: Automate support
support.body: Let AI bots handle FAQs and route conversations 24/7.

broadcast.title: Broadcast campaigns
broadcast.body: Send promotions, alerts and newsletters to all subscribers at once.

media.title: Rich interactive media
media.body: Engage users with buttons, menus, invoices and images.

hub.tipBody: Never share your bot API token publicly. If it is compromised, message @BotFather and run /revoke to generate a new one immediately. On localhost, a tunnel’s address changes each restart — press “Fix inbound” to re-register.

broadcasts.title: Telegram
broadcasts.intro: Message everyone who has chatted with your bot, then track sent, failed and blocked per broadcast.
